mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nsist_emp_mapping ( emp_cd, user_id, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm ) VALUES ( #{empCd}, #{userId}, #{initRegiPic}, #{initRegiDttm}, #{finalRvisPic}, #{finalRvisDttm} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, emp_cd, user_id, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm FROM nsist_emp_mapping WHERE emp_cd = #{empCd}
SELECT m.id, m.emp_cd, m.user_id, u.login_id, u.name, m.init_regi_dttm, m.final_rvis_dttm FROM nsist_emp_mapping m JOIN "user" u ON u.id = m.user_id ORDER BY m.id ASC
